lines.en: - You dropped this. - Um, thanks, but you--
I was gonna walk you home from school, but I couldn't find you.
- Half step to the left. - Yeah.
- I'm upset. - Aw, I think someone needs a hug.
Uh, Freddie? Freddie, we can un-hug now.
- Please let this last. - Just for the record,
the only reason you pinned me down like that was 'cause I wasn't ready.
- Are you ready now? - Yeah. Why?
Can we please not tell anyone about this?
Whoa! When did you get so strong?
Same time, the voice got lower.
I figure the sooner I get all this equipment out of here,
the sooner I could take it down to--
and then I get all this equipment out of here.
